rule: SQL written using only the saved database_task_context output for each question (blind-contexts.json). Columns absent from the pack are guessed with naive conventional names and listed in guessed; tasks whose needed tables are absent from the pack are marked no_sql when no viable query could be built.

st_kb_articles.sql: select article_id, title, view_count from support.kb_articles order by view_count desc limit 20

st_promo_codes.sql: select promo_code, discount_pct from sales.promo_codes order by discount_pct desc limit 20

syn_clients_region.sql: select r.region_code, count(*) as clients from crm.accounts a join public.regions r on r.region_id = a.region_id group by r.region_code order by clients desc

syn_staff_per_dept.sql: select d.dept_code, count(e.employee_id) as staff from hr.departments d left join hr.employees e on e.department_id = d.department_id group by d.dept_code order by staff desc

syn_qty_sold.sql: select p.sku, sum(ol.qty_ordered) as total_qty from ops.order_lines ol join inventory.products p on p.product_id = ol.product_id group by p.sku order by total_qty desc limit 20

syn_opp_amt.sql: select stage, sum(amt) as total_amt, count(*) as opps from crm.opportunities group by stage order by total_amt desc

j2_tickets_by_tier.sql: select t.tier_name, round(avg(extract(epoch from (tk.resolved_at - tk.created_at)) / 3600)::numeric, 1) as avg_hours from support.tickets tk join support.tiers t on t.tier_id = tk.tier_id where tk.resolved_at is not null group by t.tier_name order by avg_hours

j2_mrr_by_plan.sql: select plan_code, plan_name, active_subscriptions, mrr_usd from finance.v_mrr_by_plan order by mrr_usd desc

j2_campaign_leads.sql: select c.campaign_id, c.campaign_name, count(l.lead_id) as leads, count(l.converted_account_id) as converted from marketing.campaigns c join crm.leads l on l.campaign_id = c.campaign_id group by c.campaign_id, c.campaign_name order by leads desc limit 50

mh_invoice_region.sql: select v.region_code, sum(i.total_amt) as invoiced from finance.invoices i join sales.v_order_summary v on v.order_id = i.order_id where i.issued_dt >= '2026-07-01' and i.issued_dt < '2026-10-01' group by v.region_code order by invoiced desc

mh_return_rate_category.sql: select tc.category_name, count(r.return_id) as returns, count(*) as items, round(count(r.return_id)::numeric / count(*), 4) as return_rate from sales.order_items oi join inventory.products p on p.product_id = oi.product_id join inventory.product_categories c on c.category_id = p.category_id join inventory.product_categories tc on tc.category_id = coalesce(c.parent_id, c.category_id) left join sales.returns r on r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id group by tc.category_name order by return_rate desc

mh_api_failures_region.sql: select r.region_code, count(*) as failed from ops.api_request_log l join ops.api_keys k on k.api_key_id = l.api_key_id join crm.accounts a on a.account_id = k.account_id join public.regions r on r.region_id = a.region_id where l.status_code >= 400 and l.created_at >= '2026-10-10' and l.created_at < '2026-10-11' group by r.region_code order by failed desc

mh_payments_tier.sql: select v.tier, sum(p.amount) as paid from finance.payments p join finance.invoices i on i.invoice_id = p.invoice_id join sales.v_order_summary v on v.order_id = i.order_id where p.status = 'settled' and p.paid_at >= '2026-09-01' and p.paid_at < '2026-10-01' group by v.tier order by paid desc

agg_top_customers_q3_emea.sql: select customer_name, sum(total_usd) as revenue_usd from sales.v_order_summary where region_code = 'EMEA' and order_date >= '2026-07-01' and order_date < '2026-10-01' group by customer_name order by revenue_usd desc limit 10

agg_monthly_orders.sql: select date_trunc('month', order_dt) as month, count(*) as orders, sum(total_usd) as revenue_usd from sales.orders where order_dt >= '2025-01-01' and order_dt < '2026-01-01' group by 1 order by 1

agg_gl_q2.sql: with a as (select g.cost_center_id, sum(g.amount) as actual from finance.gl_entries g join finance.chart_of_accounts c on c.gl_account_id = g.gl_account_id where c.account_type = 'expense' and g.entry_date >= '2026-04-01' and g.entry_date < '2026-07-01' group by g.cost_center_id), b as (select b.cost_center_id, sum(b.budget_amt) as budget from finance.budgets b join finance.chart_of_accounts c on c.gl_account_id = b.gl_account_id where c.account_type = 'expense' and b.fiscal_month >= '2026-04-01' and b.fiscal_month < '2026-07-01' group by b.cost_center_id) select cc.cc_code, a.actual, b.budget from finance.cost_centers cc left join a on a.cost_center_id = cc.cost_center_id left join b on b.cost_center_id = cc.cost_center_id order by cc.cc_code

au_deletes_exports.sql: select u.username, a.action, count(*) as events from public.audit_log a join ops.app_users u on u.user_id = a.actor_user_id where a.action in ('delete', 'export') and a.created_at >= '2026-10-04' and a.created_at < '2026-10-11' group by u.username, a.action order by events desc limit 50

au_salary_changes.sql: select change_id, record_id, old_value, new_value, changed_at from public.change_history where table_name = 'employees' and column_name = 'salary_amt' and changed_at >= '2026-07-12' order by changed_at desc limit 50

au_failed_logins.sql: select u.user_id, u.username, count(*) as failed from ops.login_events e join ops.app_users u on u.user_id = e.user_id where e.success = false and e.created_at >= '2026-09-11' and e.created_at < '2026-10-11' group by u.user_id, u.username order by failed desc limit 20

amb_purchase_orders_late.sql: select s.supplier_name, count(*) filter (where o.received_dt > o.expected_dt) as late, count(o.received_dt) as received from ops.orders o join inventory.suppliers s on s.supplier_id = o.supplier_id group by s.supplier_name order by late desc limit 50

amb_order_shipments.sql: select round(avg(delivered_at::date - order_dt::date), 2) as avg_days from sales.orders where order_dt >= '2026-01-01' and order_dt < '2027-01-01' and delivered_at is not null

amb_support_tier.sql: select t.tier_name, count(a.account_id) as accounts from crm.accounts a join support.tiers t on t.tier_id = a.support_tier_id group by t.tier_name order by accounts desc

lg_archive_2019_region.sql: select region_txt, sum(net) as net_revenue from sales.orders_archive_2019 group by region_txt order by net_revenue desc

wd_employees_hires_2026.sql: select e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.job_title, d.dept_name, e.hire_dt from hr.employees e join hr.departments d on d.department_id = e.department_id where e.hire_dt >= '2026-01-01' order by e.hire_dt, e.employee_id limit 200

wd_products_margin.sql: select product_id, sku, product_name, list_price, unit_cost, list_price - unit_cost as margin from inventory.products order by margin desc limit 20

vg_whats_low_stock.sql: select p.sku, s.warehouse_id, s.qty_on_hand, s.qty_on_order, s.reorder_point from inventory.stock_levels s join inventory.products p on p.product_id = s.product_id where s.qty_on_hand < s.reorder_point order by s.reorder_point - s.qty_on_hand desc limit 50

vg_who_owes.note: Pack is about utm_source and lead_source (TableFox interpreted 'us' as 'utm source'); no invoice, payment or balance table was returned.

vg_churn.note: Pack interpreted 'leaving' as hr.time_off leave; no subscription, cancellation or churn table was returned.
